defects: k is typed as ℤ instead of ℕ; ArithmeticFunction.sigma expects a ℕ index, so `ArithmeticFunction.sigma (k - 1)` with k : ℤ does not typecheck (there is no automatic ℤ→ℕ coercion in Mathlib), making the statement ill-formed as written
even setting aside the type error, using ℤ subtraction for k - 1 changes the intended meaning versus the gold's ℕ-truncated subtraction (though under hk they'd agree numerically if it did typecheck)
